summary: Phase 4 consent/grant integration is correctly implemented. All six acceptance criteria are met: bridge client with config, session-bound consent with subject verification, atomic grant upsert with narrowing-only semantics, idempotent retries via hashed receipts, ownership-checked management routes, and per-invocation live grant+membership checks. No actionable defects found.
important_context: Consent routes only mount when both AUTH_BRIDGE_URL and AUTH_BRIDGE_SECRET are set (main.rs:281)
Receipt table (0030_mcp_consent_receipt.sql) stores SHA-256 of handoff token, not the token itself
Grant narrowing is enforced in upsert_in_transaction by ANDing flags and intersecting calendar IDs with the previous grant
get_mcp_grants intersects allowed_calendar_ids with live unarchived membership on every lookup (mcp_internal.rs:755-761)
